    (hpos : ∀ w ∈ U, 0 < q w ∧ q w ≤ 1)
    (Bq : ℕ → ℝ) (hBq : ∀ k w, w ∈ U → q w ≤ 1 →

    (hbaseU : ∀ m, JetRate (scaleApproach U q) q u0 m (-K0 m))
    (hbaseS : ∀ k m, JetRate (scaleApproach U q) q (s0 k) m (-Ks k m))

    (hA : ∀ j, 1 ≤ j → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (A j) U)
    (hB : ∀ j, 1 ≤ j → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (B j) U)
